approvals.reply: Good. Every honest account of dating while disabled chips away at the fiction that most daters are upfront about who they'll actually stay for. More writing like this, not less.

The cost of just getting to a date, the accessible transport, the extra planning time, never makes it into anyone's idea of what dating should cost. Calling it a tax is generous; it's a toll nobody chose to charge.
Wanting seamless access from entrance to exit shouldn't take this much hunting, in Klang Valley or anywhere else. Genuinely, good luck finding it.
